title: Megalithic architecture on Mars seen by remote viewers

tellings.quote: architecture what McMmonle and Swan saw on Mars was a style of architecture that matches the most titanic megalithic structures on Earth

plain: Joe McMoneagle and Ingo Swann were remote viewers, people who took part in experiments where they tried to describe faraway places using only the mind. They are said to have seen buildings on Mars in a style matching the largest ancient stone monuments on Earth. The philosopher Jason Jorjani passes this on, also naming a man called Karl Wolfe. He tells it because it would link the giant stone ruins on Earth to a builder that also built on Mars.
